C1488.title: Ethereum Eclipse Attack Detection Framework
C1488.summary: Eclipse attacks isolate a victim node by monopolizing its peer connections, posing a serious threat to Ethereum's consensus mechanism. This study proposes a detection framework based on a formal adversarial model for Ethereum's P2P network, aiming to systematically identify and defend against such attacks and protect nodes from being isolated from the honest network.

references.title: A Robust Eclipse Attack Detection Framework for Ethereum Networks
